notes.title: Hover Havoc Linux Release and Winter Update 2016
notes.notes:
Hover Havoc Linux Release and Winter Update 2016

As promised, Hover Havoc is now supported on Linux. We’re also proud to bring you Hover Havoc’s first ever Winter Update!

The Winter Update 2016 includes:

-    A brand new map – Gingerbread Village
-    A new game mode – Hoarder
-    Two new power-ups – The Stun Gun and the Mechanical Monkey
-    A wintry theme throughout the holiday period – Winter themed visuals added to most levels
This update also fixes some minor bugs.
You can read more about the update here [url]https://hudunigames.co.uk/canalside/HudUniGames/hover-havoc-winter-update-2016/[/url]

Thank you and Happy Holidays!
Canalside Studios

notes.title: New Game mode! - Last Man Standing
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

Just a quick announcement to let you all know that [b]Hover Havoc[/b] has a new game mode! 

[u][b]Last man standing [/b][/u] -
Battle against your opponents with limited lives, last player standing wins! 


Download and play the update now!

Thanks All, 
Canalside Studios

notes.title: Hover Havoc Now Available For Mac
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Hover Havoc is now available to purchace and dowload for Apple Mac computers. Thank you for waiting  and we hope you have a great time playing Hover Havoc. Don't worry we haven't forgot about linux users either. An update will be coming soon.

Thanks All,
Canalside Studios
